NOTE: We try to check GitHub Issues, but [forum.cursor.com](https://forum.cursor.com/) is our main channel for bug reports and feedback. Post there for the fastest response.

**Security vulnerabilities:** Do not open a public issue. Email [security-reports@cursor.com](mailto:security-reports@cursor.com). See `SECURITY.md` in this repository.
